sentences.text: (15.11.2023) The applicants/appellants 1 & 2 are the parents and the applicants/appellants no. 3 & 4 are sister and brother of the deceased-Mohd. Shafeeq who fell victim to the motor vehicle accident on 20.11.2017 on account of rash and negligent driving of an offending vehicle (Tractor) no. JK11 B 4273.

The claim petition on file no. 46/claim of 2018 came to be preferred by the applicants/appellants before the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Rajouri in which compensation for an amount of Rs.
13,99,600/- has come to be awarded along with interest @ 7.5 % per annum by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Rajouri vide its award dated 19.01.2023.

Reckoning the grant of compensation on the lesser side, the applicants/appellants are seeking its enhancement through the medium of the present appeal under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
The appeal has been filed beyond period of limitation.
For seeking condonation of delay, an application CM no. 6741/2023 has been preferred.
Issue notice to the non-applicants/respondents in CM no. 6741/2023.
Applicants/appellants to furnish registered postal covers for the service of the non-applicants/respondents within seven days,
